text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing research in the library when a
random
article catches my eye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Is Sirius Symboli Avoiding the Track?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pull it out and begin reading. It
chronicles Sirius
Symboli's career prior to
enrolling at Tracen
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Her father is a passionate teacher and
leader in the URA, and the training club
she's affiliated
with has produced many
exceptional runners."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"These two pillars pulled Sirius's
education in opposite directions and
may be the reason behind her taking a
leave of absence from
racing."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What's that you're so invested in?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, cool it with the terrified reaction.
What are
you reading that's so
stimulating, hm?

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sob... Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I... I just don't know what to do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A younger Umamusume who I assume is
one of
Sirius Symboli's mentees comes
running up to us
in tears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She tells us how her sickly mother
recently
collapsed and is in the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The hospital she's at is in my hometown,
but it's
really far away. It takes half a
day just to get
there...

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: But I... I have a race tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Okay. So, what do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Well, I...

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I want to compete, but I also want to
visit my
mom. This really isn't the time to
be racing,
though...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You know the proverb, "If you run after
two
hares, you will catch neither"?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's another idiom about killing
two birds with one stone. You're smart
enough to see
what I'm getting at here,
right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That's your answer. You decide what it is
you
want.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Seize what you desire. Give in to your
hunger. Go
after both.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You came to me for advice because
that's the
kind of Umamusume you want
to become, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If it's too much to do on your own, I'll
lend a
hand.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you want to see your mom but don't
think you can handle the post-race
proceedings or if you
need to stay out
overnight, just tell me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll make up some cover story and shake
people
off your tail.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Sirius! You'd... You'd really do that for
me?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You think I'd go back on my
word?

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No, of course not! I'll think hard about
what I
want to do... I'd better talk things
over with my
mom!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The younger Umamusume leaves in a
better
mood.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Not really. She's the one who came to
me for
advice. I just gave her my two
cents.
choice_data_list: You really do look after people, d...
You really do look after people, d...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's best for people to make
their own
decisions about their life.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
She's not a kid.
I'm sure she'll figure out
what to
do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her words make me think about that
article
again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure, her leave of absence happened in
the past,
but I'd assumed that was
something she was
forced to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I cut my thought short. After all,
it's her
decision
to choose how she wants to live.
